govisit-tools.description: GoVisit Tools is a hosted, read-only MCP server for travel discovery. Search destinations and places, and read published destination, place, category, collection, activity, FAQ, statistics, and documentation data. Streamable HTTP; no API key required. MCP setup: https://govisit.ai/en/docs/developers/mcp/overview. Agent Skills: https://govisit.ai/en/docs/developers/agent-skills/overview.
